title: Sittable Cushions
description: Cushions you can place anywhere and sit on
body:
Bringing comfort to your creations, this is a simpe mod that adds colorful cushions you can sit on. Place them on your furniture or on the ground, sit down and chat with friends or read a book.

They fall down with gravity, so they can be placed on blocks of all heights (slabs, trapdoors, etc.). They can be pushed around with pistons as well.

Crafting takes 2 wools (color of your preference) and a feather:

Note

In older versions, this mod used to be a part of XercaMod before it was split.
